answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4178 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Please guide about the rulings regarding passing through infront of others while they are in salah, in mosque. Question: assalam alykum. Please guide about the rulings regarding passing through infront of others while they are in salah, in mosque. jazakallah khair Answer ID: 4178 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 262/262=M/1429) It is sinful to pass in front of a musalli (person praying salah ). If a person is praying in open field or big mosque then one can pass in front of him after three rows, but in small mosques it is not allowable. If a person is sitting just in front of a musalli he can move his right or left. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
